findings.before: The shipped pause extractor accepted only [YO]. Its example and validation wording could be satisfied by major-cycle young/old phases alone.
findings.evidence: The unchanged extractor exited 1 on actual Temurin 25.0.3+9 logs containing lowercase y: minor phases. zGCIdPrinter.cpp explicitly emits y for minor and a Y/O tag for major. Raw failure and original snippet retained.
findings.consequence: Normal minor-cycle input aborted extraction; using only the example missed the defect.
findings.correction: Accept exactly [yYO], show minor phase records, document prefix case, and require real minor and major validation. Retain strict failure for unsupported phase/prefix/duration shapes.
findings.validation: Same captured log now yields 73 samples; independent grouping confirms 39 lowercase-y minor records. Empty/malformed/unknown-prefix/missing-file controls preserve intended semantics.

findings.before: The package discussed stall capture completeness and capacity signals but did not explicitly constrain cause-to-wait cardinality or warn that the stall schema lacks gcId.
findings.evidence: Pinned metadata and runtime EventType inspection show gcId on young/old events but not ZAllocationStall. Allocator requests asynchronous GC before wait, commits type/size after wait/synchronization, and can request further cycles while allocations remain pending.
findings.consequence: An analysis could equate an Allocation Stall GC cause with one wait, invent a direct stall gcId join, or turn summed waits into a global pause/request latency.
findings.correction: Separate causes, cycle records and completed waits; correlate by thread/time with ambiguity; label sum of overlapping waits as aggregate blocked-thread time.
findings.validation: Runtime schema assertions passed; source paths inspected. Probe recorded 15 young and 3 old events but zero stall instances, so instance-level relationship was not dynamically exercised.

findings.before: Schematic wording stated that a major cycle starts both generations with Y: Pause Mark Start (Major).
findings.evidence: Pinned zDriverMajor::collect_young can run major_full_preclean before major_full_roots; actual explicit-GC log has an earlier Y: Pause Mark Start.
findings.consequence: A valid full-collection path could be misread as an impossible sequence or encourage a fixed pause-count assumption.
findings.correction: Qualify combined young/old marking and optional initial young preclean; preserve repeated mark-end and no fixed-sequence/count caveats.
findings.validation: Source and captured log inspection; no separate workload required after the existing finite probe.

findings.before: G1 comparison described a 512-byte card as fixed.
findings.evidence: Pinned gc_globals.hpp defines GCCardSizeInBytes with default 512 and a configurable constrained range.
findings.consequence: Readers could incorrectly apply the default to a nondefault target while explaining memory granularity.
findings.correction: State 512-byte default and inspect effective GCCardSizeInBytes. Preserve byte-per-card versus bit-per-potential-slot distinction.
findings.validation: Primary-source check; no claim of runtime G1 flag testing in this assignment.

preserved: JDK 21/23/24/25 generational-mode lifecycle and exact-build flag verification.
Conditional heap sizing and stall-remediation choices; no universal multiplier or default-flag fix.
Pointer-metadata load-barrier ordering, architecture/compiler/access-specific generated-code attribution, store barrier and remembered-set distinctions.
Two bitmap roles, relaxed concurrent marking and page-to-slot mapping caveats.
Safe isolated capture commands, producer-status handling, rotation/window coverage and retained artifacts.
Pause Relocate Start inclusion; per-phase nearest-rank semantics; empty p99 undefined and incomplete captures qualified.
JFR metadata versus instances/enablement/threshold/completion distinction; running stalls may not yet commit.
Thread dump state versus native CPU evidence; boundaries to neighboring operational and pause-attribution skills.
